old_caption: The video captures a man performing a series of exercises on a smooth, dark gray floor against a plain white wall. He is shirtless, wearing light gray shorts with white stripes on the sides, and has tattoos visible on his arms and legs. The man begins in a quadruped position, with his hands and knees on the ground. He then transitions into a downward dog pose, lifting his hips high while keeping his hands and feet planted firmly on the ground. His body forms an inverted V-shape, with his arms straight and his legs bent at the knees. The lighting is bright, casting soft shadows behind him, emphasizing the contours of his muscles. The background remains static throughout the sequence, focusing entirely on the man's fluid and controlled movements. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary, capturing the entire sequence without any noticeable changes in angle or zoom.

caption: The video captures a shirtless, bearded man in light-grey shorts moving across a dark padded mat in a low, hands-on-the-ground crouch. His torso stays nearly horizontal, head facing down toward the right, while the plain white wall remains behind him. The camera is stationary, so his whole body gradually translates rightward along the mat seams. One hand remains planted while the other lifts, reaches forward, and contacts the floor ahead of it, repeating in a crawl-like sequence. As the hands advance, his trailing leg changes from an extended position with the heel raised to a lower crouch with the knee near the mat and the foot contacting the floor. The trailing foot shifts rightward with the body rather than staying fixed at the left edge. A bright diagonal streak of light on the wall behind his back becomes visible and persists through the later frames. He remains low, hands supporting, and moving forward through the visible sequence.
